company.name: Clumio
company.shortDescription: Clumio delivers cloud-based data protection and backup services tailored to enterprise needs.
company.description:
Clumio delivers cloud-based data protection and backup services tailored to enterprise needs. They offer a platform that provides backup (BaaS) service for various cloud environments, including AWS, VMware Cloud on AWS, and Microsoft 365.

Clumio aims to simplify data protection by offering a unified backup solution spanning on-premises data centers and cloud infrastructure. Their platform is designed to be scalable, efficient, and easy to manage. It leverages cloud-native technologies to provide backup, recovery, and compliance features.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based, agentless backup and recovery platform for AWS and Microsoft 365 workloads, including applications, databases, data lakes, and SaaS data.
productsAndServices.name: Clumio Platform

productsAndServices.description: A data risk assessment service that analyzes an organization’s AWS data estate and provides visibility into its backup and security risk posture.

aiResearchSummary.text: Clumio is researching methods for cloud-based data protection and backup, as shown by work on protection groups for backing up cloud-based key-value stores, which enables rapid determination of expired objects and efficient management of storage resources. Additionally, they are developing data protection services using isolated, encrypted backup data to enhance security for organizational data. These areas reflect Clumio’s focus on secure, efficient cloud backup and data management.
